scope: Two-Phase model initialization only; no data read, forward, gradient or training
author_policy: Each source script resets the same seed independently before its model construction/training
unified_policy: One whole-pipeline seed; FT is constructed before PRE; PRE consumes the CPU RNG stream advanced by FT construction; no stage-transition reseed

results.FT_matches_independently_reseeded_author: 3/3 seeds for both layer counts, every tensor equal

decision: Keep the frozen unified pipeline and disclose the seed-stream difference; do not withdraw/rerun or switch policy after test exposure
reason: Registered seeds specify deterministic whole-pipeline runs, not per-stage resets. Architectures, objectives, data splits and training hyperparameters are unchanged. Switching random-stream policy is another experimental design, not a neutral code correction.
limitation: Do not claim seed-matched per-stage initializations or stochastic trajectories equal to the author scripts. A stage-reseed experiment would require separate preregistration and a separate result table.
